module_summary: Multi-cycle radix-2 restoring divider: valid/ready handshake starts 8 counted iterations that trial-subtract a negated divisor from a remainder/quotient shift register, then sign-correct the result.

anchors.name: opn_valid
anchors.why: Operation request; when idle loads operands, SR, NEG_DIVISOR and starts the counter.

anchors.name: res_valid
anchors.why: Result-valid register set at cnt[3], cleared on res_ready acceptance; blocks new operations.

anchors.name: result
anchors.why: Sign-corrected {remainder, quotient} output derived from SR.

anchors.name: SR
anchors.why: Remainder/quotient shift register updated each iteration with mux_result and CO bit.

anchors.name: start_cnt
anchors.why: Idle/busy state bit gating the division iterations and operand capture.

anchors.name: cnt
anchors.why: Iteration counter; cnt[3] ends division and raises res_valid.

anchors.name: NEG_DIVISOR
anchors.why: Latched negated divisor added to remainder for trial subtraction.

anchors.name: CO
anchors.why: Trial-subtract carry: selects restored or subtracted remainder and becomes the quotient bit.

anchors.name: res_ready
anchors.why: Consumer accept; with res_valid clears the result-valid flag.

anchors.name: sign
anchors.why: Selects signed vs unsigned division: abs conversion and result sign correction.

anchors.name: dividend
anchors.why: Dividend operand, abs value loaded into SR and saved for sign fixup.

anchors.name: divisor
anchors.why: Divisor operand, negated into NEG_DIVISOR and saved for sign fixup.

anchors.name: sub_result
anchors.why: Trial subtraction of divisor from current remainder.

anchors.name: mux_result
anchors.why: Restoring mux output: new partial remainder written back to SR.

anchors.name: dividend_save
anchors.why: Saved dividend; its sign bit drives remainder and quotient sign correction.

anchors.name: divisor_save
anchors.why: Saved divisor; its sign bit drives quotient sign correction.

groups.name: div_control
groups.description: Busy flag, iteration counter and valid/ready result handshake.

groups.name: restoring_datapath
groups.description: Trial subtract, restore mux and remainder/quotient shift register.

groups.name: sign_correction
groups.description: Saved operand signs negate remainder and quotient for signed result.
